channel.title: Drawdy Blog
channel.description: Updates, announcements, and design thinking from the Drawdy team.

item.title: Introducing Drawdy: The Infinite Canvas for Builders
item.description: Meet Drawdy — the whiteboard that thinks like code. An infinite canvas designed for system thinkers, architects, and builders.

item.title: Fast + Optimized Board
item.description: Speed isn't a feature — it's the foundation. Here's how Drawdy stays fast with thousands of elements on the canvas.

item.title: Real-Time Collaboration Without Compromise
item.description: How we built multiplayer collaboration on top of a local-first architecture — without sacrificing speed or privacy.

item.title: From Excalidraw to Drawdy: What's Different
item.description: Excalidraw changed how we think about whiteboards. Here's how Drawdy builds on that foundation — and where it goes further.

item.title: Building a Plugin API for the Canvas
item.description: Drawdy's plugin API lets you extend the canvas with custom nodes, integrations, and workflows. Here's our approach to building an extensible platform.

item.title: Hand-Drawn UI: The Design Philosophy Behind Drawdy
item.description: Why Drawdy looks sketchy on purpose — and how hand-drawn aesthetics change the way people think and collaborate.

item.title: Version History and Why It Should Be Free
item.description: Version history shouldn't be a premium feature. Here's why Drawdy includes unlimited version history for everyone — and how we built it.

item.title: Our Roadmap: What's Coming Next
item.description: A transparent look at what we're building next — from collaboration features to the plugin ecosystem and beyond.
